_comment: The claim registry additions of 14-ghost-design §10.3 (11-brand §8 holds C1 to C23). tools/check-copy.py check (4): a copy sentence that carries one of a claim's markers must be one of its registered sentences ({variables} match their value, or nothing where a page binds it with data-v); a claim with `requires` needs that sentence on the same page, or a link to where it is stated (`requires_link`). `labels` are buttons and headings that carry a marker without making a claim.

sentences: It gets locked right here, before it goes anywhere.
The key hides in the link, after the # sign.

claims.condition: always (child form of C1; the server also sees the C3 and C4 metadata, said on /made#who)
sentences: Our server gets scrambled noise. Never the key.

claims.condition: always; downloads in progress delay it up to {ticket_min} minutes; C5-snap and C6 apply
sentences: We delete our scrambled copy.
Then it's gone. We delete our scrambled copy.

claims.condition: after the exit is in a SealLog checkpoint; before it, the pending form
sentences: Its goodbye is written on the Tari chain, for anyone to check.
We wrote its goodbye on the Tari chain.
Its goodbye goes on the Tari chain within {checkpoint_min} minutes.

claims.condition: every exit is added to SealLog at the next checkpoint (within {checkpoint_min} minutes); it proves we said we deleted it, not that we kept no copy
sentences: Then it's gone, and its goodbye goes on the Tari chain.

claims.condition: /verify checks the inclusion proof against the SealLog root on chain; the judges' demo secret is burned at least {checkpoint_min} minutes before the tag
sentences: Its goodbye on the Tari chain, checked by your browser.

claims.condition: courier sends; relay mode means we learn the address (C8)
sentences: Or send it to a Tari address. Only they can open it.
It goes by Tari. Only they can open it.

claims.condition: rule Once (the default); gone = the link ends and C24 applies; an unopened link ends at its expiry
sentences: You get a link. Your friend sees it once.
It opens one time in the next {anon_max_expiry}. Then it's gone.
Same link. Now it opens one time.
It opens one time. When you open it, it's gone.
It opens one time, until {date}. Then the link ends.
It opens one time. Then the link ends.

claims.condition: rule A few times: min(3, max_views), set in place only while views_used = 0
sentences: It opens up to {few} times in the next {anon_max_expiry}. Then it's gone.
Same link. Now it opens up to {few} times.
It opens up to {few} times, until {date}. Then the link ends.
It opens up to {few} times. Then the link ends.

claims.condition: kind 3 only (the default send and every dead drop); kind 4 files open with that wallet's view key, so C15 sits on every view-key screen; deleted if only kind 4 ships (spec G2)
markers: no file sent to your locker
lists arrivals and opens no file
claims.requires: A view key can't spend, but it can read everything sent to this address, including files.
sentences: For files sent to your locker: you see that something came, and how much. Not the file.
What came, and how much. No file sent to your locker opens with it.
For files sent to a locker, the view-key screen lists arrivals and opens no file. Files sent to another wallet open with its view key.
We store a random id and a hash of your login key. No email and no public key; a dead drop stores its own address, by design.

claims.condition: adding or removing a secret word
claims.backed_by: spec §5.4 (a password is a new link and the old one is revoked)
sentences: This makes a new link. The old one stops working.
New link made. The old one stopped working.

claims.condition: every money screen (child form of C19)
sentences: {network} testnet: tTARI is test money, worth nothing. Ootle mainnet: {mainnet_date}.
{network} testnet: tTARI is test money, worth nothing. The Ootle mainnet is live; {brand} stays on the testnet until our code is reviewed.

markers: lives in this browser. No email
nobody can let you back in
sentences: It lives in this browser. No email, no password.
Save your key. If this browser forgets it, nobody can let you back in, not even us.

claims.backed_by: spec §5.3 (the reveal gate burns only on Open it)
sentences: Scan it to open it on a phone. That uses its one look.

public_key: A sentence about what we store may name public keys only to say we store none (C29).
